plan.selection_rule: At least four added wins over parent plus observed mechanism; choose most wins, tie order recovery/structures/single_heal.
plan.validation_rule: One frozen winner; 120 independent seeds, 12/class. Versus parent: gain>=0.05 and exact paired p<0.025. Versus baseline: gain>=0.10 and p<0.025. No flagged regression in either 55-test sweep. Both wins gates must pass.
plan.stop_rule: Do not inspect validation aggregates early, change N, tune on validation cases, or validate another winner in this study.
plan.scope: Local baseline-filled rosters only. No live-field superiority claim. All three suggestions receive full discovery experiments; only a qualifying winner gets confirmation.

purchase_diagnosis.cases: all ten classes, parent and single-heal; selected by first discovery seed, not outcome
purchase_diagnosis.method: Recorded commands were applied through the published simulator at the normal decision point, observing real acceptance and gold changes; every subsequent tick hash and complete action consumption were verified.
purchase_diagnosis.limitations: One correlated seed cluster. Gold/equipment totals depend on game length; this is mechanism evidence, not a win-rate verdict. The original discovery gate is unchanged.
